stated: The Conservative Party will keep turning the tide against fraudsters by banning SIM farms and cold calls on financial products, building on the work of the National Fraud Squad.

source.quote: We will ban SIM farms, which are used to send bulk messages for fraudulent texts, and ban cold calls on financial products so fraudsters cannot dupe people into buying fake investments.

bearing_set.reason: Fraud is a crime; banning SIM farms and cold-call scams on financial products, and building the National Fraud Squad, are policing/crime-prevention measures that directly bear on crime rates and justice system effectiveness.

membership_note: Single-target crime-reduction policy. O10 (liberty) cost is negligible: SIM farms have virtually no legitimate personal use and financial cold-call bans are standard commercial regulation with minimal individual-liberty implications. Financial losses to fraud victims could gesture toward O2/O11, but those pathways run entirely through the O5 crime-rate mechanism and do not independently move cost-of-living or tax-burden indicators in a non-negligible way.
